228	def calculate_head_turn(kps):
229	    """Calculates 3D head turn ratio using the 5 major facial keypoints"""
230	    if kps is None or len(kps) < 3:
231	        return 0.5 # 0.5 means looking perfectly straight ahead
232	
233	    left_eye = kps[0]
234	    right_eye = kps[1]
235	    nose = kps[2]
236	
237	    # Measure the horizontal distance from the nose to each eye
238	    dist_left = abs(nose[0] - left_eye[0])
239	    dist_right = abs(right_eye[0] - nose[0])
240	    
241	    total_dist = dist_left + dist_right
242	    if total_dist == 0: return 0.5
243	
244	    return float(dist_left / total_dist)
